ruleDefinitions.name: Users Added to Global or Device Admin Roles
ruleDefinitions.description: Monitor and alert for users added to device admin roles. Note: Unmapped fields: Category, OperationName, TargetResources

sequences.query: (Category = "RoleManagement" AND (OperationName = RGX(".*Add.*") AND OperationName = RGX(".*member\\ to\\ role.*")) AND (TargetResources = RGX(".*7698a772\\-787b\\-4ac8\\-901f\\-60d6b08affd2.*") OR TargetResources = RGX(".*62e90394\\-69f5\\-4237\\-9190\\-012177145e10.*")))
